      • Filemodule

        public static final ProcModCallNode Filemodule()
                                        throws ParseException
        File module grammar production. A scope for this file module, fmscope, is created here and passed to all modules, procedures and functions declared within this file module. It is a static scope. Variables created within this file module can be accessed from within any modules, procedures and functions declared within it even though this file module scope may no longer be on the call stack.
        Returns:
        module/procedure call node
        Throws:
        ParseException - on a parsing error
